items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know a lot about him, and know some of the stuff that happened to him.

ctx.x: And just - I mean everything. His scope was so broad.

Listen. Here’s a guy like - he’s a little elephant guy like Strayhorn, you know. He was very sweet. I know a lot about him, and know some of the stuff that happened to him. He didn’t go out just going out.
